title: Plan related work with milestones
summary: A milestone groups issues and merge requests around a goal or period. It helps show what work remains for that goal.
introduction: A milestone groups issues and merge requests around a goal or period. It helps show what work remains for that goal. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain plan related work with milestones
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A milestone groups issues and merge requests around a goal or period. It helps show what work remains for that goal.

blocks.code:
Milestone: Reading-list first demo
Issue 1: show sample books
Issue 2: add a search box
Issue 3: check keyboard use
blocks.title: Plan related work with milestones

blocks.text: The three tasks support one demo goal. Completing a milestone requires checking the intended outcomes, not only changing task labels.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Add a task that checks an empty search result.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A milestone due date is a plan, not evidence that unfinished work is complete.
For more detail later, use this [GitLab further reading](https://docs.gitlab.com/tutorials/).
